recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic, matte-grey 3D bust of a male figure wearing thick black sunglasses and heavy jewelry. The sculpture features eroded, cracked sections revealing translucent blue crystalline structures growing from within the head and neck.
coreVisualRelationships: Matte grey plaster texture versus high-gloss black eyewear
Organic facial features versus sharp, geometric internal crystals
Heavy, fluid-like jewelry chains contrasting with the rigid bust form
Soft, diffused studio lighting against deep shadows in the cracks
coreInvariants: Braided hair texture in the same matte material

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up bust view, occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast black sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the dark sunglasses, moves down to the complex jewelry, then travels upward through the cracks and crystals in the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform light grey background providing a clean, clinical atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the sunglasses and the bust.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are rendered as 3D objects with a dripping, liquid-metal or melting wax effect
Same matte grey material as the bust
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs feature bulbous, teardrop-shaped extensions at the base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: None; the custom lettering acts as a singular graphic element.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, rounded volume of the pendant
Matches the melting aesthetic of the jewelry

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D matte grey bust of a man with braided hair and black sunglasses, featuring cracked skin revealing blue crystals, wearing a heavy snake-link chain without a pendant.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D matte grey pendant with custom dripping-style lettering centered on the chest, matching the lighting and texture of the bust.

verificationChecks: Is the texture matte and plaster-like?
Are the crystals translucent and pale blue?
Is the text integrated as a 3D object?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue accent color
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sunglasses are the only pure black element.
Check that the dripping text is legible but stylized.
Verify the braided hair texture matches the skin material.
Confirm the crystals appear to be emerging from inside the head.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [Subject] bust in [Material: Matte Grey Plaster] with [Feature: Eroded Cracks] revealing [Internal Element: Blue Crystals], wearing [Accessory: Black Sunglasses] and [Graphic: 3D Dripping Lettering Pendant].
